method: All 11 original studio images and six actual world frames inspected. Scores reflect pixels, not builder assertions. Existing support scan retained for unchanged terrace and transform.

representationResult.finding: The slab and trim now stop together at the main wall. The angled spike across the upper front facade is gone in front, front-left, front-right, top and clay-front. Roof remains solid and attached in opposite/clay views. The earlier front/rear corbel correction remains effective, leaving both door crowns clear.
representationResult.scoreHistory: Architectural attachment 0.79 at r01, 0.84 rejected at r02, 0.90 at r03. Total gain from original 0.11; r03 is the baseline review of a genuinely different construction family, not a second parameter correction of the retired family.
representationResult.regressions: No critical regression greater than 0.05. Main roof, annex proportions, openings, chimneys, terrace and root placement retain the accepted silhouette.

familyLedger.representation: buried rectangular annex roof with independently shortened trim

assembly.findings: All three entries remain clear. Removed shrub and relocated cargo do not reappear in either front approach. The low annex remains separate from cottage02; cottage04/guild separation is unchanged. No new terrain, foliage or support issue is visible.
assembly.supportAssessment: Retain the approved nine-point terrain-only scan for unchanged base/transform: every footprint sample intersects supporting terrain, including both rear corners with 0.084 world units overlap. Updated views are consistent with that support.

finishControls: Freeze accepted macro and clipped roof boundary. Annex finish courses must use that same wall termination rather than restore the retired protruding rectangle. Keep the small upper-left window gap clear of roof courses/flashing; it is the tightest accepted macro contact.
release: Finish may begin. It requires its own independent finish and final assembly gate.
remainingTargetGap: Slate/clay layers, masonry, timber, shutters and smokehouse-specific detail remain deliberately absent. Approval does not claim exact inferred-reference identity or complete island V2.
